title: Public Alert No. 01/2026 – Sale of Falsified TAVANIC® 500mg Tablet in Nigeria
summary: NAFDAC warns of falsified Tavanic® 500mg tablets (Sanofi) labelled batch 4MW4C, Mfg 05/2024, Exp 04/2027, traced to the open drug market at Idumota, Lagos. Blister stickers hid an older expired batch (2PK3C) and the MAS label differs from the authorised distributor's.
